'''Jenith Spaceport''' serviced the town of [[Jenith]] on the planet [[Chelloa]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The spaceport was used by [[Daiman]] and was guarded by several [[Daimanate Sith trooper]]s. It was used to load and unload goods including [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] into [[cargo liner]]s. The spaceport also included the [[South Work Yard]] and many storerooms.

It was [[Raid on Chelloa|raided]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] as part of the second phase of [[Operation Influx]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. The spaceport was not badly damaged by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s [[kinetic corruptor]] and was later used to host a fleet of transport ships and kinetic corruptors disguised as [[mobile munitions complex]]es. The spaceport was subsequently destroyed during the [[Destruction of Chelloa]] but not before the [[Freedom Fleet]] successfully evacuated offworld.
